scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @tradesense/core && npm run build -w @tradesense/adapters
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @tradesense/server && npm run build -w @tradesense/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @tradesense/server" "npm run dev -w @tradesense/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @tradesense/server && npm run typecheck -w @tradesense/web
